title: Randall Bennett (Vidpresso founder) — 'the most important current book on AI alignment'
summary: Randall Bennett — founder of Vidpresso (acquired by Facebook in 2018, customers included NBC, BuzzFeed, Reuters, BMW, NASDAQ) — is one chapter into Incorruptible and frames it on X as the most important current book on AI alignment because of how it treats organizational inertia.
blockquote:
i'm like one chapter into @ericries 's new book about avoiding organizational corruption, and i'm pretty sure it's the most important current book on AI alignment.

ai has inertia , and setting up objective ways of measuring trajectory of ai will be the thing that saves us.
